card.title: Vice President of Quality
card.description:
We are partnering with a leading global prestige beauty and skincare company to identify a
**Vice President of Quality**
to lead its North American Quality organization.

This is a high-impact executive leadership opportunity for a commercially minded quality professional who can connect quality, regulatory compliance, manufacturing excellence, and business performance within a complex, global organization.

The successful candidate will oversee Quality across North American manufacturing and distribution operations, providing leadership to a network of internal manufacturing operations and external manufacturing partners across multiple continents.

**About The Opportunity**

Reporting into senior global leadership, the Vice President of Quality will lead an organization of approximately 100 professionals, with four Directors reporting directly into the role.

The scope encompasses contract manufacturing quality, factory quality (QA, QC, laboratories, and Quality Management Systems), and quality assurance across North America, while providing technical quality leadership and guidance to teams in Canada and Brazil.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead the North American Quality organization:**
 Provide strategic direction and leadership across manufacturing, quality assurance, quality control, laboratories, and quality systems.
* **Act as the business voice of Quality:**
 Partner with commercial, brand, manufacturing, and executive stakeholders to translate quality and regulatory requirements into sound business decisions.
* **Drive regulatory and compliance excellence:**
 Ensure alignment between global quality standards and US regulatory requirements, particularly FDA OTC regulations and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* **Oversee contract manufacturing quality:**
 Provide quality leadership and oversight across a network of approximately 30–40 contract manufacturing partners, including key strategic suppliers.
* **Strengthen organizational capabilities:**
 Develop a technically strong team, promote greater autonomy, build leadership capabilities, and establish succession depth.
* **Partner with manufacturing leadership:**
 Work closely with plant and operational leaders to balance quality expectations with production demands, providing constructive challenge and driving continuous improvement.
* **Lead through influence:**
 Build strong relationships across a global, multicultural, and matrixed organization, including teams and stakeholders outside of the direct reporting structure.
* **Prepare the organization for future growth:**
 Build the organizational structure, capabilities, and relationships necessary to support a potentially broader international Quality remit.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Extensive leadership experience in Quality within beauty, personal care, consumer health, or complex consumer goods manufacturing environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with
 **FDA OTC regulations and GMP requirements**
 .
* Proven experience leading large, multi-layered Quality organizations and developing senior leadership teams.
* Experience overseeing contract manufacturers, external manufacturing partners, and complex supplier networks.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing quality, QA, QC, laboratory operations, and Quality Management Systems.
* Commercially oriented leadership approach, with the ability to translate technical and regulatory considerations into practical business decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate effectively within global, matrixed organizations.
* Experience balancing quality standards, operational performance, and business priorities.
* Conversational French is considered a strong advantage.

card.title: Regional Director of Operations
card.description:
**Regional Director of Operations (LNHA) – Iowa**
=================================================

**Company:** EMY Healthcare 
**Location:** Cedar Rapids–Des Moines, Iowa Region 
**Position Type:** Full-Time 
**Work Location:** Field-Based / Multiple Skilled Nursing Facilities 
**Travel:** Regular Regional Travel Required

### **About EMY Healthcare**

EMY Healthcare is a growing healthcare organization dedicated to providing exceptional skilled nursing, rehabilitation, and long-term care services throughout the Midwest. We are committed to delivering quality care, supporting our employees, and building strong, successful facilities through hands-on leadership and operational excellence.

As we continue expanding throughout Iowa, we are seeking an experienced, motivated, and results-driven **Regional Director of Operations (LNHA)** to oversee multiple skilled nursing facilities across the Cedar Rapids–Des Moines region.

### **Position Overview**

The Regional Director of Operations will provide operational leadership, oversight, and support to approximately 5–6 skilled nursing facilities located throughout the Cedar Rapids–Des Moines corridor, with the majority of facilities concentrated in the Cedar Rapids area.

**This position requires an active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license and significant skilled nursing operational experience.**

This is a hands-on, field-based leadership position requiring regular travel between facilities. Candidates may reside in the Cedar Rapids, Iowa City, Des Moines, or surrounding areas, provided they are willing and able to travel regularly throughout the assigned region.

The ideal candidate will have a proven background in skilled nursing operations, a strong understanding of regulatory compliance and financial performance, and demonstrated success leading administrators, improving facility performance, and driving operational results.

We are looking for a leader who is proactive, organized, accountable, and comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with corporate and regional leadership.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Leadership & Facility Oversight**

* Provide direct operational oversight and support to approximately 5–6 skilled nursing facilities.
* Lead, mentor, and hold facility administrators accountable for operational, clinical, and financial performance.
* Conduct regular on-site visits to evaluate operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide hands-on support.
* Establish clear performance expectations and ensure consistent execution of company policies and operational standards.
* Assist facilities in resolving operational challenges and implementing sustainable improvements.
* Support administrator recruitment, onboarding, development, and retention.

**Financial Performance & Census Development**

* Oversee facility financial performance, including budgets, labor management, operating expenses, and profitability.
* Review financial statements, operational reports, and key performance indicators to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
* Work with administrators to develop and implement strategies to improve census, payer mix, and revenue.
* Monitor staffing levels, overtime, agency utilization, and labor costs while maintaining appropriate resident care.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and financial performance without compromising quality of care.

**Regulatory Compliance & Quality Improvement**

* Ensure facilities maintain compliance with applicable federal and state regulations.
* Partner with clinical leadership to support survey readiness, quality improvement initiatives, and corrective action plans.
* Assist administrators in addressing survey deficiencies, regulatory concerns, and operational risks.
* Promote a culture of accountability, resident-centered care, and continuous improvement.
* Support facilities through surveys, audits, and other regulatory activities as needed.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Work closely with facility administrators, Directors of Nursing, regional clinical leadership, and corporate departments.
* Conduct regular operational meetings and follow up on action plans and performance objectives.
* Provide guidance and support during leadership transitions, operational challenges, and facility improvement initiatives.
* Communicate regularly with executive leadership regarding facility performance, challenges, and opportunities.
* Help implement company-wide initiatives and best practices across assigned facilities.

### **Qualifications**

**Required:**

* **Current, active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license. Iowa licensure preferred; candidates licensed in another state must be eligible to obtain Iowa licensure.**
* Significant experience in skilled nursing facility (SNF) or long-term care operations.
* Previous experience as a Nursing Home Administrator, Regional Director of Operations, or comparable skilled nursing operational leadership role.
* Strong understanding of nursing home operations, regulatory compliance, financial management, staffing, and census development.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams, improve operational performance, and hold facility leadership accountable.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple facilities and competing priorities.
* **Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout the Cedar Rapids–Des Moines region.**
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

**Preferred:**

* Previous multi-facility or regional operations experience.
* Proven success improving facility financial performance, census, quality measures, and operational efficiency.
* Experience with facility turnarounds, acquisitions, or operational transitions.
* Familiarity with PointClickCare and skilled nursing operational reporting systems.
* Knowledge of Iowa nursing home regulations and survey processes.

### **What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation based on experience.
* Health insurance and employee benefits.
* 401(k) with company match.
* Travel reimbursement.
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* Supportive corporate and regional leadership.
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact across multiple facilities within a growing healthcare organization.

### **Work Location & Travel Requirements**

**This is a regional, field-based position covering skilled nursing facilities between Des Moines and Cedar Rapids, Iowa, with the majority of facilities concentrated in the Cedar Rapids area.**

* Candidates may reside anywhere within reasonable traveling distance of the assigned facilities.
* Regular, in-person facility visits are an essential part of the position.
* The role requires flexibility to travel throughout the assigned region based on operational needs.
* Administrative responsibilities may be completed from home when not traveling or visiting facilities.
* Travel expenses will be reimbursed in accordance with company policy.

**This is not a fully remote position. Candidates must be comfortable maintaining an active, on-site presence across multiple skilled nursing facilities.**

### **Join Our Team**

If you are a Licensed Nursing Home Administrator with a strong background in skilled nursing operations who enjoys developing teams, improving facility performance, and making a meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you.

Join EMY Healthcare and help us continue growing while delivering **Excellence with Empathy**.

card.title: Head of NA Operations, Professional Lines & Canada
card.description:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

We are seeking an accomplished operations leader to lead the operational strategy, performance and transformation agenda supporting our North America Professional Lines & Canada businesses. 
This is a senior leadership role supporting specialty insurance businesses with more than $1 billion in annual revenue and significant ambitions for continued growth. The Head of Operations will partner closely with senior Underwriting leaders to build operational capabilities that enable profitable growth, increase underwriting capacity, strengthen service and controls, and improve how we work. 
The successful candidate will combine strong commercial and insurance knowledge with operational expertise and a passion for transformation. They will be equally comfortable shaping strategy with senior leaders and working with teams to understand challenges, simplify processes and turn opportunities into measurable results.

**What You'll Do** 
 

* Serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior Professional Lines & Canadian Underwriting leaders.
* Translate business strategy, portfolio priorities and growth ambitions into operational priorities and capabilities.
* Build strong relationships across Underwriting and Operations to identify opportunities to improve productivity, responsiveness and the underwriting experience.
* Balance enterprise standards with the specific requirements of individual underwriting businesses.

Lead Operational Performance 

* Lead a large underwriting support organization with accountability for service, quality, productivity, capacity and operational performance.
* Establish clear performance measures and service standards across the underwriting lifecycle.
* Use data and business insight to identify root causes, resolve performance issues and continuously improve results.
* Maintain a strong operational control environment with clear ownership and accountability.

Transform How We Work 

* Lead the development and implementation of scalable target operating models that simplify work, reduce unnecessary handoffs and create underwriting capacity.
* Evaluate processes end to end and identify opportunities to improve speed, accuracy, consistency and service.
* Build compelling cases for change based on data, business impact and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure transformation initiatives move beyond implementation to deliver sustainable improvements in business performance.

Harness Technology, Data & AI 

* Partner with Technology, Data and business leaders to modernize underwriting workflows and operating practices.
* Identify and implement practical opportunities to use workflow, automation and AI to increase underwriting capacity, improve service and strengthen operational controls.
* Ensure technology investments translate into measurable business value, colleague adoption and sustainable operating improvements.

Build a High-Performing Organization 

* Build and develop a high-performing Operations organization characterized by strong business partnership, accountability, curiosity and disciplined execution.
* Develop leaders, strengthen succession pipelines and build commercial, insurance and operational capability across the team.
* Foster an inclusive environment where colleagues are encouraged to challenge existing ways of working, solve problems and improve the business.
* Align workforce and capacity plans with business demand, service expectations and anticipated growth.
* Use productivity and performance insights to guide organization design, resource allocation and investment decisions.

**What You'll Bring**

* 10+ years of progressive experience within commercial P&C insurance, including significant experience in Underwriting Operations, Underwriting Support or a closely related function.
* Significant leadership experience, including responsibility for managers and large or geographically distributed teams.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end underwriting lifecycle and the operational capabilities required to support a specialty insurance business.
* Demonstrated success partnering with senior Underwriting and business leaders and translating strategy into execution.
* Proven experience designing and implementing operating models and leading complex operational transformation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated experience using data to identify root causes and improve business performance.
* Experience applying technology, workflow, automation and data to improve underwriting or operational outcomes.
* Strong understanding of operational controls, service management and continuous improvement.
* A track record of leading change from concept through implementation and delivering measurable results.
* Strong commercial judgment and exceptional stakeholder-management and communication skills.
* A collaborative, hands-on leadership style, with the confidence to challenge constructively and create accountability for outcomes.
* Experience managing budgets, resources and workforce plans.
* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree or relevant insurance qualification preferred.

What Success Looks Like 
The successful candidate will help create a more scalable, responsive and technology-enabled operating model that: 

* Increases underwriting capacity and allows underwriters to focus more of their time on underwriting, portfolio management, broker relationships and profitable growth.
* Delivers measurable improvements in service, productivity, quality and operational control.
* Supports continued business growth without proportionate increases in cost or operational complexity.
* Converts technology, automation and AI investments into meaningful business outcomes.
* Builds a strong leadership bench and a high-performing Operations organization with clear accountability for results.

This is an opportunity to play a significant leadership role in shaping how Operations enables the next phase of growth in our North America Professional Lines & Canada businesses.

**Role Factors**

The role requires you to be in office 3 days per week. Travel may be included.

 

**What We Offer**

For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $180,000 - $235,000. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more. Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.

**This posting is for an existing vacancy.**

Schumacher & Co. is an innovative interior design company that is disrupting the $150 billion-dollar global interior design industry. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what is next, an appreciation for what's come before, a drive to make our products with enormous care and attention for detail. F. Schumacher & Co is a globally recognized company with a myriad of showrooms both domestically and internationally.

Our competitive advantage in the industry is our people. We believe that our employees are our most important assets. F. Schumacher & Co is deeply anchored in our company's core values which are as follows:

* Preserve our Start-up spirit

* Take Ownership & Accountability

* Be Solutions-Oriented

* Demonstrate Courage

* Practice Adaptability

* Embrace Collaboration

We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer's journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio. This role leads our **Paramount Handprints manufacturing operations** — our internal product mills based in Passaic, NJ and the Brooklyn Navy Yard — which are a critical differentiator for the business, providing craft and flexibility across our portfolio.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on **Sr. Director of Operations** to lead manufacturing operations across our two internal product mills: **one in Passaic, NJ** which produces hand screen-printed fabric and wallcoverings in Passaic, NJ, and another in the Brooklyn Navy Yard which prints digital wallcoverings, both for FS&CO and third-party customers. This individual will oversee the full manufacturing process — from receiving and inventory through order entry, craft printing, quality assurance, shipping and client communications.

This is a builder role. The ideal candidate is scrappy and entrepreneurial, comfortable operating in a hands-on, evolving environment, while also bringing rigor, standards, and consistency to a growing operation. They will balance our commitment to craftsmanship with the need for cost efficiency and anticipate that capabilities and capacity will continue to evolve over time.

This role is based full-time, on-site in Passaic, NJ, five days a week, with occasional travel to our Brooklyn Navy Yard and SoHo locations as needed. It reports to the **Head of Portfolio Development**.

 

**What You'll Do**

* **Leadership**: Lead a team of approximately 60 across both mills.

* Directly manage the Director of Production Planning, Director of Production, Shipping & Warehouse Leads, and Senior Digital Printers at each site and indirectly oversee their teams.

* Oversee the CX leader responsible for order entry and client communication.

* Build a strong, accountable culture across both sites; recruit, develop, and retain talent at all levels.

* **Manufacturing Operations**: Oversee the end-to-end manufacturing process and P&L ownership across both sites, including:

* Warehouse receiving and inventory management

* Screen engraving, color mixing, and trialing

* Production

* Quality assurance and printing

* Cutting, packing, and shipping

* **Process improvement & margin management**: Bring consistency and standardization reliability to our operations.

* Balance craftsmanship with efficiency to protect and improve margin across the mills' output

* Identify and implement process improvements that increase throughput, quality, and reliability without compromising craft.

card.title: Sr. Director, Operations - RMS
card.description:
The Senior Director, Operations – RMS is a critical leadership role with responsibility for the operational performance of the RMS site network across North America and EMEA. 
 
The role provides leadership across all RMS breeding, production and operational sites, ensuring that the global operating network is aligned with the company's broader commercial, financial and operational objectives. 
 
The Senior Director is responsible for translating global strategy into actionable operational plans and ensuring consistent execution across sites. The role balances strategic oversight with active operational engagement, working closely with Site Leaders to improve performance, strengthen operational discipline and ensure the organization is positioned to respond effectively to changing customer and commercial requirements. 
 
RMS operates across a complex network of sites with differing species, production models, infrastructure, regulatory environments and market requirements. The Senior Director is responsible for creating greater consistency in operational performance while recognizing and managing legitimate differences between sites. 
 
The role works closely with Commercial, SIOP, Production, Finance, Technical Services, Veterinary Services, Animal Welfare, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, HR and other functions to ensure that customer demand, production capability, workforce, resources and financial objectives are appropriately aligned. 
 
The Senior Director is accountable for operational performance, cost efficiency, productivity, service delivery, leadership capability and continuous improvement across the RMS operating network. 
 
The role partners closely with the Sr Strategic Production Leader, who provides specialist technical expertise in production capability, production mapping, capacity, biological production assumptions, production optimization and production-related risk. 
 
The Senior Director does not need to be the organization’s deepest technical production expert. The role requires sufficient understanding of RMS production to make informed operational decisions, challenge assumptions and translate technical considerations into business outcomes.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Strategic & Operational Leadership**

* Translate RMS strategy into actionable global operational plans, ensuring alignment with broader organizational and commercial goals.
* Provide operational leadership across all RMS sites in North America and EMEA.
* Establish clear operational priorities, performance expectations and accountability across the site network.
* Ensure Site Leaders and operational teams understand their responsibilities for delivering business, operational, customer and people outcomes.
* Develop greater consistency in operating standards, management processes and performance expectations across sites.
* Balance global standardization with appropriate local requirements and regulatory differences.
* Identify structural and operational barriers to performance and lead actions to address them.
* Ensure the RMS operating network works as an integrated business rather than a collection of individual sites.
* Provide regular operational insight, risks and recommendations to the Senior Vice President, RMS Operations.

**Operational Execution & Performance**

* Drive effective day-to-day operational execution through Site Leaders and operational leadership teams.
* Ensure sites operate efficiently and consistently against agreed operational standards.
* Identify and address operational inefficiencies, performance gaps and resource constraints.
* Establish a strong operating rhythm across the global RMS network.
* Ensure operational issues are identified early, appropriately escalated and resolved.
* Promote structured problem solving and accountability for sustainable solutions.
* Maintain visibility of operational performance across sites and ensure corrective actions are delivered.
* Balance immediate operational requirements with longer-term business priorities.

**Efficiency & Productivity Optimization**

* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, productivity and resource utilization.
* Drive initiatives that improve labor productivity and operational effectiveness.
* Challenge inefficient processes, structures and ways of working.
* Promote standardization and sharing of best practice across sites.
* Work with Site Leaders to identify opportunities to improve utilization of labor, facilities and other resources.
* Ensure productivity improvements are sustainable and do not compromise quality, animal welfare, biosecurity or regulatory requirements.
* Partner with the Head of Production to convert technical production opportunities into measurable operational improvements.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Commercial, SIOP and Production to align operational capability with customer demand.
* Partner with the Head of Production to understand production capability, constraints and technical risks.
* Work with SIOP to ensure operational plans reflect realistic production and capacity assumptions.
* Partner with Finance to align operational performance with financial objectives.
* Work with Technical Services, Veterinary, Animal Welfare, Quality and Regulatory functions to ensure operational requirements are appropriately managed.
* Partner with HR to align organizational structures, workforce requirements and leadership capability with business needs.
* Ensure cross-functional decisions are translated into clear operational actions and accountabilities.

**Customer Focus**

* Ensure operational activities are aligned with customer expectations and commercial requirements.
* Develop a customer-focused culture across RMS operations.
* Ensure customer commitments are supported by realistic operational and production plans.
* Identify operational risks that could affect customer delivery and ensure appropriate mitigation.
* Work with Commercial, SIOP and Production to balance customer requirements with capacity, cost, quality and operational constraints.
* Ensure customer focus does not compromise regulatory, welfare, quality or biosecurity standards.

**Process Improvement & Innovation**

* Lead continuous improvement across the RMS operational network.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, productivity, reliability and operational effectiveness.
* Sponsor cross-site improvement initiatives and ensure successful practices are transferred across the network.
* Encourage data-driven problem solving and evidence-based decision making.
* Lead change initiatives involving new systems, technologies, operating models and processes.
* Ensure improvement programs deliver measurable and sustainable benefits.
* Partner with the Head of Production on technically driven production improvement initiatives.

**Data-Driven Decision Making**

* Establish appropriate global RMS operational KPIs and performance measures.
* Utilize data and analytics to understand operational performance and identify trends.
* Develop and maintain performance dashboards and reporting mechanisms.
* Ensure KPIs are aligned with strategic, commercial and financial objectives.
* Use data to identify systemic issues rather than treating performance problems as isolated site issues.
* Ensure performance information is used to drive action and accountability.
* Provide regular performance reporting and insight to the Senior Vice President, RMS Operations.

**Financial Accountability & Margin Contribution**

* Manage the operational contribution to RMS financial performance.
* Partner with Finance to improve cost efficiency and gross profit margin.
* Translate financial targets into operational priorities and actions.
* Identify and address operational cost drivers.
* Challenge labor, resource and operational assumptions where appropriate.
* Support accurate operational forecasting and budget planning.
* Ensure operational investment decisions are supported by clear business cases.
* Drive cost-saving initiatives without compromising quality, welfare, biosecurity or operational sustainability.
* Ensure operational decisions consider both short-term financial performance and long-term capability.

**Capacity & Network Planning**

* Work with SIOP, Commercial and Production to understand current and future capacity requirements.
* Ensure operational resources are aligned with expected demand.
* Partner with the Head of Production to understand production capacity and biological constraints.
* Identify structural capacity constraints and develop appropriate operational responses.
* Support strategic decisions regarding site capability, infrastructure, footprint and investment.
* Assess the operational implications of changes in demand, customer requirements, species or production strategy.
* Ensure capacity decisions consider workforce, infrastructure, production, financial and customer requirements together.

**People Development & Culture**

* Lead and develop Site Leaders and senior operational leaders across North America and EMEA.
* Build a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, collaboration and operational discipline.
* Establish clear leadership expectations across RMS Operations.
* Identify high-potential individuals and create opportunities for development.
* Strengthen succession plans for critical operational leadership roles.
* Provide coaching and feedback to operational leaders.
* Hold leaders accountable for both performance and leadership behaviors.
* Build greater leadership capability across the global RMS network.
* Encourage leaders to solve problems at the appropriate level rather than relying on unnecessary escalation.

**Workforce & Organizational Effectiveness**

* Partner with HR and Finance to ensure workforce structures support business requirements.
* Ensure operational workforce levels are aligned with demand, production requirements and financial objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve workforce deployment and productivity.
* Challenge legacy structures and fixed workforce assumptions where business conditions require greater flexibility.
* Support organizational changes required to improve operational performance.
* Ensure critical operational capabilities are identified and developed.
* Align organizational design with the future requirements of the RMS business.

**Compliance, Quality, Animal Welfare & Risk**

* Maintain operational accountability for compliance across RMS sites.
* Ensure operational decisions incorporate regulatory, quality, animal welfare, veterinary and biosecurity requirements.
* Work closely with Quality, Veterinary, Animal Welfare and Regulatory functions.
* Ensure significant operational risks are identified, understood and actively managed.
* Establish appropriate escalation and response mechanisms for significant operational incidents.
* Ensure operational performance and financial pressures never compromise compliance, welfare, quality or biosecurity.
* Promote a culture in which compliance and welfare are embedded within operational decision making.

**Minimum Requirements**

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Operations, Business, Engineering, Animal Science, Agribusiness, Life Sciences or related discipline. Advanced degree preferred.

**Experience**

10+ years of progressive operational leadership experience, preferably including multi-site or geographically dispersed operations.

**Operational Leadership**

Demonstrated experience leading operational teams through Site Leaders, General Managers or other senior leaders.

**Financial Acumen**

Strong understanding of budgets, cost efficiency, labor productivity, resource utilization and margin improvement.

**Commercial Understanding**

Ability to understand customer requirements and translate commercial priorities into operational actions.

**Data-Driven Leadership**

Experience using operational data and KPIs to guide decisions and improve performance.

**Transformation**

Experience leading operational improvement, transformation, restructuring or change initiatives.

**Regulatory Environment**

Experience operating within a regulated, compliance-sensitive or technically complex environment.

**Global Experience**

Experience working across multiple countries, cultures or geographically dispersed operations.

**RMS / Industry Knowledge**

Experience in RMS, animal breeding, animal production, agriculture, life sciences, manufacturing or another technically complex operational environment is advantageous.

**TRAVEL**

~40% travel both domestica and international

The anticipated base salary for this position could range from between $141,800 to $195,000 and will depend, in part, on the successful candidate’s qualifications for the role, including education and experience. Benefits include health and dental coverage, short- and long-term disability, paid time off, 401K participation with company match, etc.

* *This position could be offered at different levels for candidates who qualify with a combination of advanced levels of education and/or years of experience. The salary range will adjust along with the level of the role to match the person’s relevant experience and/or education level.*

*At Inotiv, our work helps advance the development of new medicines and therapies that can improve people's lives. As a leading global contract research organization (CRO), we partner with researchers to tackle complex scientific challenges, drive innovation, and help build a healthier, safer world. Bringing together scientists, researchers, technical experts, and business professionals, we provide the expertise and collaboration needed to move research forward. Our people make this work possible, and we value the knowledge, ideas, and contributions each person brings to the team. Whether you are starting your career or bringing years of experience, Inotiv offers opportunities to learn, grow, and play a meaningful role in advancing treatments for patients around the world.*

*Salary will be commensurate with experience and responsibilities. Benefits include health and dental coverage, short- and long-term disability, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401K, and more!*

*Inotiv is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to provide a fair and equal employment opportunity to all persons, regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law. This policy governs all aspects of employment, including selection, job assignment, compensation, discipline, termination and access to benefits and training.*

card.description:
For 75 years, Charles River employees have worked together to assist in the discovery, development and safe manufacture of new drug therapies. When you join our family, you will have a significant impact on the health and well-being of people across the globe. Whether your background is in life sciences, finance, IT, sales or another area, your skills will play an important role in the work we perform. In return, we’ll help you build a career that you can feel passionate about.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Serve as the senior scientific advisor and strategic lead for laboratory operations within Global Laboratory Sciences. Partner with scientific and operational leaders within Lab Sciences to ensure operational excellence, scientific quality, regulatory compliance and customer satisfaction across the global laboratory network. Develop and action an operational strategy that supports growth of the business with a focus on innovation and building global capacity and capabilities to meet the evolving needs of the industry. Provide leadership across multiple laboratory disciplines and sites, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement. Serve as a recognized expert for Global Lab Sciences to internal and external partners. Lead and manage Global Lab Sciences projects as assigned.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Direct global laboratory operations across multiple disciplines in Global Lab Sciences, including Analytical Chemistry, Bioanalysis, Biomarkers, Immunology and Molecular Biology
* Ensure efficient utilization of laboratory resources, equipment, facilities, and personnel
* Work with the Global Head of Labs to develop and implement a global operational strategy aligned with business objectives
* Provide oversight of Global Scientific Leads, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement. Leverage Global Teams to drive global consistency in laboratory procedures, quality systems and client deliverables
* Serve as primary reviewer for harmonized (HRM) standard operating procedures (SOPs) and document templates
* Direct key strategic and scientific decision-making for Global Laboratory Operations. Address and resolve scientific and operational challenges to ensure consistent and high-quality customer experience
* Partner closely with Site Leadership and Quality Assurance to ensure successful outcomes during regulatory inspections, client audits, internal audits and accreditation reviews
* Support sites in implementing key operational metrics to monitor performance, throughput and capacity
* Help to drive expansion, modernization, automation, and capacity planning initiatives
* Serve as Global Lab Sciences lead in DSA operational initiatives, as assigned
* Support the development and integration of new technologies to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability across the Global Lab Sciences organization
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of current industry practices and represent Lab Sciences in scientific forums, conferences and industry organizations. Participate in client governance committees, as assigned
* Identify opportunities for growth and develop business plans for new areas of opportunity
* Serve as a member of the Global Lab Sciences senior leadership team and contribute to quarterly Business Review and DSA strategy presentations
* Mentor staff and assist in development of succession plans and talent pipelines
* Perform all other related duties as assigned.

**Job Qualifications**
----------------------

* ***Education:*** Advanced degree (Master’s Degree and/or Ph.D.) in scientific or business-related discipline.
* ***Experience:*** 10 years related management experience in a contract research organization (CRO), biotechnology, or pharmaceutical environment, including one or more of the scientific areas covered within Laboratory Sciences.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may be accepted as a satisfactory substitute.
* ***Certification/Licensure:*** None
* ***Other:*** Management and problem-solving skills. Demonstrated abilities in analytical, quantitative and critical thinking with fundamental understanding of Lab Sciences capabilities and capacity. Proven ability to work effectively in a dynamic, deadline driven environment. Ability to handle multiple projects and make executive level decisions. Strong communication, interpersonal, organizational skills, and attention to detail. Proficient project management and presentation skills. Must have ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

**Compensation Data**
---------------------

The hiring range for this position in the United States is $200,000/yr – $235,000/yr USD. Please note that salaries vary within the range based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, education, certifications, location and any collective agreements, if applicable. Remote candidates located outside the United States should be aware that the relevant pay range varies based on country and location.

**About Safety Assessment** 
Charles River is committed to helping our partners expedite their preclinical drug development with exceptional safety assessment services, state-of-the-art facilities and expert regulatory guidance. From individual specialty toxicology and IND enabling studies to tailored packages and total laboratory support, our deeply experienced team can design and execute programs that anticipate challenges and avoid roadblocks for a smooth, efficient journey to market. Each year approximately 300 investigational new drug (IND) programs are conducted in our Safety Assessment facilities.

**About Charles River** 
Charles River is an early-stage contract research organization (CRO). We have built upon our foundation of laboratory animal medicine and science to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non-GLP, to support clients from target identification through preclinical development. Charles River also provides a suite of products and services to support our clients’ clinical laboratory testing needs and manufacturing activities. Utilizing this broad portfolio of products and services enables our clients to create a more flexible drug development model, which reduces their costs, enhances their productivity and effectiveness to increase speed to market.

With over 20,000 employees within 110 facilities in over 20 countries around the globe, we are strategically positioned to coordinate worldwide resources and apply multidisciplinary perspectives in resolving our client’s unique challenges. Our client base includes global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, government agencies and hospitals and academic institutions around the world.

At Charles River, we are passionate about our role in improving the quality of people’s lives. Our mission, our excellent science and our strong sense of purpose guide us in all that we do, and we approach each day with the knowledge that our work helps to improve the health and well-being of many across the globe. We have proudly worked on 80% of the drugs approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in the past five years.

We’re committed to providing benefits that elevate your quality of life. Based on your position these may include: bonus/incentives based on performance, 401K, paid time off, stock purchase program, Health and wellness coverage, employee and family wellbeing support programs, and work life balance flexibility.

At Vestis®, we provide uniforms, workplace supplies, and professional cleaning that help businesses simplify their workday and keep their teams safe, confident, and focused on what matters most. More than a provider, we are a partner in productivity, trusted to keep you running.
 
Join us and build a career supporting the people who make it all work.
 
 
Overview
 
The Vice President of Distribution Center Operations will lead the product distribution strategy and drive an economically competitive operation that delivers both best-in-class customer experience and distribution cost advantages across all facilities supporting Vestis Rental and Direct Sale customers.
 
This leader will influence and reinforce a portfolio of core values and accountability standards centered on safety, workforce engagement, customer experience, operational efficiency, and innovative solutions that support business goals. This role is responsible for deploying strategies and actionable plans that deliver measurable performance improvement.
 
This leader will also define and advance the technology roadmap for Distribution Center Operations, identifying opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence (AI), robotics, automation, advanced analytics, and other emerging technologies to improve safety, productivity, quality, service, capacity, and cost.
 
The Vice President will promote data-driven performance visibility, real-time corrective action, and strong cross-functional collaboration. This leader will work effectively with business partners to identify, address, and resolve operational issues.
 
This role will set goals and oversee key metrics related to customer fill rates, customer satisfaction, footprint utilization, inventory management, optimization and total DC cost, along with other key measures tied to Distribution Center Operations.

* Set and deliver the overall vision and distribution strategy for national and international distribution centers to ensure end-to-end customer needs are met at the lowest possible cost.
* Lead a high-performing team of supply chain practitioners, with direct and indirect responsibility for an organization of more than 600 employees.

* Define objectives, establish key performance metrics, and create a regular review cadence across safety, quality, fill rate, customer satisfaction, inventory management, budget performance, and other critical operating areas.
* Implement metrics, processes, and operating routines that drive accountability and ensure results.
* Improve costs year over year through disciplined operational execution and continuous improvement.
* Drive performance improvement through the use of continuous improvement methodology.
* Build strong cross-functional partnerships to identify, escalate, and resolve operational issues and improvement opportunities.

* Ability to think, plan, and execute strategically.
* Ability to influence and build consensus with executive leadership.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity.
* Decisive and persuasive, with a strong sense of urgency and a proven ability to drive results.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Excellent analytical skills and technical capabilities.

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
Restaurant Depot is the nation’s leading members-only, wholesale cash-and-carry supplier serving independent restaurants, caterers, delis, convenience stores, & other foodservice businesses across 165+ locations in 35 states. Our stores offer bulk quantities of fresh meat, seafood, produce, dairy, frozen foods, grocery items, beverages, paper goods, cleaning supplies, restaurant equipment, & more. Open seven days a week, we are committed to delivering quality products, competitive pricing, & exceptional service to our members. As we continue to grow, we are seeking an experienced Director of Operations to provide strategic leadership, drive operational performance, & support the continued success of our store network.

**Position Summary**

The Director of Operations provides strategic leadership & operational oversight for a multi-region portfolio of stores. This role is responsible for driving business performance through operational excellence, financial accountability, talent development, customer experience, regulatory compliance, & growth initiatives. The Director partners closely with executive leadership to develop & execute company strategies while leading Regional Managers & field leadership teams in achieving organizational goals.

This position plays a key role in establishing operational standards, improving profitability, developing future leaders, & ensuring consistent execution across all locations. Responsibilities include oversight of P&L performance, labor management, sales growth, food safety, regulatory compliance, customer satisfaction, workforce planning, & organizational development.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Business Performance**

* Develop & execute operational strategies that support company growth, sales performance, & profitability objectives.
* Lead Regional Managers & field leadership teams through clear performance expectations, accountability measures, & ongoing performance reviews.
* Analyze sales, labor, margin, shrink, inventory, & operational metrics to identify opportunities & implement corrective actions.
* Drive sustainable sales growth, market share expansion, & EBITDA improvement across assigned regions.
* Partner with executive leadership on long-term business planning, budgets, capital investments, & new store development opportunities.
* Ensure operational priorities align with company objectives & strategic initiatives.

**Financial Management & Operational Excellence**

* Maintain accountability for P&L performance across assigned regions & divisions.
* Develop annual operating plans, labor strategies, budgets, & financial forecasts.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including sales growth, gross margin, labor productivity, inventory turns, EBITDA, shrink, & waste.
* Establish & maintain consistent operational standards across all locations.
* Ensure effective execution of company programs, policies, procedures, & initiatives.
* Lead continuous improvement efforts focused on productivity, efficiency, process optimization, & customer experience.
* Drive accountability for operational audits, food safety standards, inventory accuracy, & facility maintenance.
* Implement best practices to improve profitability & overall operating efficiency.

**Customer Experience & Brand Standards**

* Champion a customer-first culture throughout the organization.
* Ensure stores consistently deliver exceptional customer service & maintain company brand standards.
* Review customer feedback & satisfaction trends, developing action plans to address opportunities for improvement.
* Lead initiatives that strengthen customer loyalty, retention, & overall brand reputation.

**Talent Development & Workforce Management**

* Build a strong leadership pipeline through succession planning, talent development, & career progression opportunities.
* Coach & develop Regional Managers, District Managers, Store Managers, & emerging leaders.
* Establish leadership development programs & promote internal growth opportunities.
* Lead performance management processes & reinforce organizational accountability.
* Develop workforce & labor strategies that maximize productivity while supporting operational needs.
* Ensure staffing models, recruitment, & retention initiatives align with current & future business requirements.
* Oversee labor budgets, staffing levels, & productivity targets across assigned regions.
* Foster a culture of engagement, collaboration, accountability, & continuous improvement.

**Compliance, Risk Management & Food Safety**

* Ensure compliance with company policies & applicable federal, state, & local regulations.
* Maintain accountability for food safety, HACCP, OSHA, labor law compliance, & health department standards.
* Partner with Human Resources & Legal teams on employee relations matters, investigations, & risk mitigation.
* Lead operational audits & corrective action programs to address compliance & performance gaps.
* Ensure all locations meet company standards for workplace safety, security, & regulatory compliance.

**Change Management & Strategic Initiatives**

* Lead companywide operational initiatives, process improvements, & transformational projects.
* Support acquisitions, store integrations, remodels, & new store openings.
* Drive adoption of new technologies, operating procedures, & business processes.
* Collaborate with executive leadership on strategic growth initiatives & organizational priorities.

**Communication & Executive Partnership**

* Serve as a key operational liaison between field leadership & executive management.
* Provide executive reporting on operational performance, business trends, risks, & opportunities.
* Facilitate regular business reviews with Regional Managers & key stakeholders.
* Communicate company vision, priorities, & performance expectations throughout the organization.
* Partner with cross-functional departments to improve operational alignment & execution.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Retail Management, or a related field required; MBA preferred.
* 10–15 years of progressive multi-unit operations leadership experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience leading Regional Managers, District Managers, or equivalent senior field leadership teams.
* Demonstrated success managing large-scale, high-volume, multi-location operations.
* Proven track record of driving sales growth, profitability improvement, & operational excellence.
* Strong background in P&L management, labor management, financial analysis, budgeting, & strategic planning.
* Experience leading organizational change, business transformation, & large-scale operational initiatives.
* Extensive knowledge of regulatory compliance, food safety, labor laws, & risk management.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, coaching, & team development skills.
* Advanced analytical, decision-making, & problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to travel extensively throughout assigned regions.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive salary commensurate with experience
* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance Coverage
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Match
* Paid Time Off (PTO) in accordance with company policy
* Six (6) Paid Company Holidays
* Tuition Reimbursement Program, subject to eligibility & plan guidelines
* Additional Voluntary Supplemental Benefits, which may include life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance programs, & other optional benefits
* Competitive & Comprehensive Benefits Package Designed to Support You & Your Family

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
TerraImm, Inc. is seeking a dynamic, results-driven Director of Operations & Sales Growth to lead our sales organization, accelerate revenue growth, and strengthen overall business operations.
 
This is a key leadership opportunity for an experienced professional with a proven track record of building successful sales teams, developing effective sales strategies, and delivering measurable business results.

We are looking for a leader who knows how to motivate a team, establish accountability, identify opportunities for growth, and turn ambitious business objectives into actionable strategies.
 
The ideal candidate combines strong sales leadership, operational expertise, and a hands-on management approach.

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Sales Leadership & Revenue Growth**

* Lead, develop, and manage the sales organization with a primary focus on increasing revenue, improving conversion rates, and achieving aggressive growth objectives.
* Develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies designed to expand market reach, increase customer acquisition, and drive sustainable business growth.
* Establish clear sales goals, individual performance expectations, and measurable revenue targets.
* Coach, mentor, and motivate sales professionals to improve performance, strengthen sales techniques, and consistently achieve established goals.
* Evaluate sales performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement targeted training and development initiatives.
* Oversee sales pipeline management, lead distribution, prospect follow-up, appointment setting, and closing strategies.
* Implement effective sales processes and accountability measures to ensure consistent execution across the sales team.
* Identify opportunities to expand sales channels, improve lead generation, and strengthen customer acquisition strategies.
* Partner with marketing leadership to align campaigns, lead generation efforts, and sales objectives.

**Sales Performance, KPIs & Accountability**

* Develop, monitor, and report on key sales performance indicators, including:
 + Outbound calls and customer contacts
 + Qualified prospects and appointments scheduled
 + Estimates and proposals delivered
 + Lead-to-appointment conversion rates
 + Appointment-to-estimate conversion rates
 + Estimate-to-close conversion rates
 + Closed sales and revenue generated

**Operational Leadership & Business Efficiency**

* Develop and implement operational strategies, policies, and procedures that support business growth and scalability.
* Identify inefficiencies, streamline workflows, and implement solutions that improve productivity and service delivery.
* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve consistency, accountability, and operational effectiveness.
* Ensure the organization's operational infrastructure can support increased sales volume and business expansion.

**Team Development & Organizational Growth**

* Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing sales professionals and operational leaders.
* Build a performance-driven culture that encourages ownership, teamwork, accountability, and professional growth.
* Lead by example through active involvement, strong communication, and a commitment to measurable results.

**Financial Performance & Executive Collaboration**

* Work closely with executive leadership and Finance & Administration to establish revenue objectives, operational budgets, and financial performance goals.
* Identify business risks and implement solutions that support sustainable growth.
* Support compliance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements, coordinating immigration-related matters with appropriate legal professionals.

 

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

* Proven track record of leading sales teams and achieving measurable revenue growth.
* Demonstrated success in developing and executing sales strategies, improving conversion rates, and increasing team productivity.
* Strong experience with sales pipeline management, CRM systems, forecasting, and performance reporting.
* Proven ability to coach, motivate, and develop sales professionals while maintaining high performance expectations.
* Experience establishing and monitoring sales KPIs, revenue targets, and individual performance metrics.
* Strong operational management skills, including process improvement, workflow optimization, and organizational development.
* Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.
* Experience in immigration services, professional services, consulting, or related industries is preferred but not required.
* Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is preferred but not required.

 

The ideal candidate is a confident, proactive leader who knows how to set expectations, develop talent, measure performance, and deliver results. You understand that successful sales leadership requires more than setting goals. It requires coaching, accountability, consistent execution, and the ability to turn opportunities into revenue. You are equally comfortable analyzing performance reports, developing growth strategies, coaching a sales representative, or working alongside executive leadership to solve operational challenges.

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
**DIRECTOR OF OPERATIONS**

*Ritchey Livestock ID* | Fort Collins, Colorado | Full-Time, Onsite

Run the Operation. Build the Team. Shape What's Next.

**This Role Is For Builders.**

**We're looking for someone who can run a great operation today—and help build the company we'll become tomorrow.**

At Ritchey Livestock ID, we believe farmers and ranchers are the unsung heroes of our world. They work long hours, in every kind of weather, doing the essential work of feeding the rest of us. They don't ask for much in return. The least we can do is get our little part right.

For more than 60 years, we've manufactured livestock identification tags that ranchers can count on. Our products may be small, but the responsibility we feel to our customers is anything but.

We're a profitable, growing American manufacturer with a loyal nationwide customer base. We've recently completed the largest facility investment in our company's history, opening a new manufacturing operation in Fort Collins, Colorado. Now we're building the people, systems, and culture to carry Ritchey into its next chapter.

**We're looking for a hands-on Director of Operations who can lead that effort—and potentially grow into a broader executive leadership role as the company evolves.**

This is not a position for someone who wants to lead from behind a desk. You'll spend meaningful time on the production floor, working alongside your managers, solving real problems, and helping people succeed.

You'll also be expected to think beyond today's production schedule: developing leaders, building systems, improving performance, and preparing Ritchey for its next stage of growth.

**The Opportunity**

You'll lead approximately 45 people across manufacturing, engraving, shipping, and related operations, working directly with our CEO.

Your mission is twofold: **Run an exceptional operation today. Build the people, processes, and accountability that make excellence repeatable tomorrow.**

You'll own performance across safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, cost, and team development.

You'll be responsible for developing department managers, improving operational systems, driving continuous improvement, and building a culture where people take pride in their work and ownership of their results.

**Your First Year: Real Challenges, Real Opportunity**

We've made a major investment in our future. Now comes the work of making that investment pay off.

Here are five challenges you'll help us tackle:

* **Strengthen our new manufacturing operation.** Continue ramping up our Fort Collins facility, improving production stability, quality, capacity, and efficiency.
* **Improve scheduling and throughput.** Build better production planning and workflows across manufacturing, engraving, and shipping to improve delivery performance and reduce bottlenecks.
* **Build systems that last.** Reduce dependence on individual employees by developing practical SOPs, standardized processes, clear performance measures, and repeatable operating routines.
* **Develop our next generation of leaders.** Coach newer managers, strengthen accountability, and build employee development practices that help great people grow.
* **Drive continuous improvement.** Use Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and practical root-cause problem-solving to reduce waste, improve productivity, and create measurable, sustainable improvements.

You'll have meaningful ownership of these challenges, the support of our leadership team, and the freedom to make a lasting impact.

**Who We're Looking For**

We're looking for a rare combination of heart, head, and hands. Someone who can lead people, build systems, solve problems, and roll up their sleeves when the work demands it.

**What you must bring:**

* **Proven People Leadership:** Demonstrated success leading teams in a manufacturing or production environment, ideally 20 or more employees, with experience developing supervisors or managers and holding people accountable.
* **Demonstrated Systems Building:** A track record of improving processes, implementing operational improvements, and building systems that continue to work without your constant involvement.
* **High Agency & Ownership:** The judgment, initiative, work ethic, and follow-through to take responsibility for results, solve difficult problems, and lead confidently in a hands-on environment.

**What we'd love to see:**

* Experience in plastic injection molding, extrusion, or related manufacturing processes.
* Practical experience applying Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other structured continuous improvement methods. Certifications are valued but not required.
* Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems, production scheduling, inventory management, purchasing, and quality systems.
* Strong financial and analytical skills, with an understanding of how operational decisions affect profitability.
* Experience developing managers, building teams, and helping an organization prepare for growth.

We value experience, but we're far more interested in what you've accomplished than the number of years on your résumé.

**Seasoned plastics professionals and exceptional leaders from other manufacturing environments are equally encouraged to apply.** What matters most is demonstrated leadership, systems thinking, operational judgment, and a willingness to keep learning.

***The Ritchey Way***

Our culture is built around one simple commitment: **DO RIGHT BY THE RANCH.**

Four core principles guide how we show up every day:

**ASK WHY. ASK WHAT IF.** — Learn the work. Make it better.

**MAKE THE SMALL THINGS COUNT.** — Bring care to the details, seen or unseen.

**NO SIDELINES.** — See it. Say it. Help solve it.

**BE GOOD TO WORK WITH.** — Carry your share. Be good company.

These aren't just words on a wall. They're the standards we hold ourselves and each other to. As our Director of Operations, you'll help bring *The Ritchey Way* to life through your leadership, your example, and the team you build.

**Why Ritchey?**

We're small enough that your ideas matter, but established and ambitious enough that your work can make a lasting difference. You'll have direct access to ownership, real authority to drive improvement, and a genuine opportunity to help shape the company's future.

**We're intentionally looking for someone with the potential to grow beyond operations.**

card.title: Sr. Manager, Reaction Injection Molding, Operations
card.description:
**What to Expect**

The Senior Manager, CyberCab Reaction Injection Mold – Operations sets the vision and strategic path for the Production Maintenance & Engineering organizations. This role leads the production, maintenance, tool & die and Engineering teams and works collaboratively with cross-functional partners to achieve Safety, People, Quality, Production/Delivery, and Cost KPI targets of the organization, as well as establishing a high-performance culture.
 
 
This role is responsible for production and resource planning for all exterior panels of CyberCab, provides coaching, mentoring, and developing leaders; launching new programs successfully; and daily tactical planning and execution to achieve the build plan and meet safety, quality, rate, and cost targets. The person in this role must be capable of guiding the team through complex issues, distilling large volumes of data to solve problems, and driving day-over-day continuous improvement.
 
 
This Senior Manager provides hands-on support, leadership, and direction to both teams on all operational, team morale, and equipment-related matters. The person in this role is responsible for building teams that work cohesively and perform at the highest level, keeping Tesla’s mission and the goals of the organization in mind. Your technical judgement and Operating discipline will drive decisions with Engineering, NPI, Programs, Quality, Materials and Upstream/Downstream shops.

 
**What You'll Do**

* Set the vision and strategic path for the Production, Maintenance & Engineering organizations within Cybercab, and lead the team to achieve Safety, People, Quality, Production, and Cost KPI targets and objectives of the organization
* Drive tactical planning to achieve the production build plan with the highest safety, quality, and yield performance
* Launch new programs and lead production ramps and product design changes successfully through resource planning, program management, and partnership with the NPI, Manufacturing Engineering, and Design Engineering teams
* Work with the team to identify production bottlenecks and achieve ramp plans by addressing availability, efficiency, and yield constraints on the line. Coach and mentor the team on data collection and analysis, complex problem solving, and driving daily improvements
* Guide the team through root cause analysis, methodical problem solving, and first-principles thinking. Maintain a culture of adherence to standardized work and compliance with documented processes and procedures so that safe practices and building products to quality specification are sustained
* Lead the maintenance team on equipment availability, preventive and predictive maintenance programs, project planning, and equipment improvements based on downtime data analysis. Establish and maintain equipment spare parts to achieve availability targets and build rates
* Be entrepreneurial and make quick decisions in ambiguous situations. Build a high-performing team, set clear expectations and goals, and manage performance effectively with clear, concise feedback loops
* Maintain a strong technical understanding of product design, intent, processes, and equipment theory of operation. Identify bottlenecks, balance the line, and work closely with the engineering team to solve problems, increase availability, and drive process improvements
* Create a comprehensive strategy for Tool & Die as well as Engineering teams for strong collaboration, same goal visions and strong partnership from dies to machine parametrization
* Work with HR and other teams to improve team morale and create an environment in which team members want to come to work and perform at the highest level

 
**What You'll Bring**

* 10–12 years of leadership and manufacturing experience, preferably in the automotive industry or a highly technical manufacturing environment
* Analytical, detail-oriented, self-driven critical thinker who communicates proactively with all employees and works well in a fast-paced, multicultural environment
* Experience with process-improvement methodologies to improve efficiency, increase yield and availability, and apply design of experiments and statistical methods
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong interpersonal skills. Ability to work well under pressure, manage competing demands, juggle priorities, and meet tight deadlines with diligent follow-through
* Hands-on experience implementing lean methodologies and world-class manufacturing practices
* Ability to use structured problem-solving methods and techniques to successfully resolve production problems, such as 8D, fishbone diagrams, and 5-Why analysis
* Ability to foster close working relationships with team members, management, and cross-functional groups. Highly collaborative, with a positive impact on the team overall
* High-level leadership and decision-making skills. A strong sense of urgency and drive to succeed
* Proficiency in MS Office, Visio, CAD, SPC charts, data-analysis tools, Jira, Tableau/BI dashboards, and project-management tools as well as basic level of prompting or deep curiosity for SI learning

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
* Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)

 
 
Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. 
 
Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.
